lines.text: Attend me now, and make thy pledge
I shall take it straight back
when an Orb lies before me
I smash through all before me
that Orb shall be yours no more
Nay, thy claim must now yield
Then the fence shall come down
I shall cast it to ground
then I cut to the right
I am built like a cupboard
and through thee I shall thunder
with the wind on my face
I am gone from thy side
now thou shalt not have it back
